items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Lands EPYC Role In New AI Security System
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) has been selected by Google Cloud to supply EPYC CPUs for the new TPU 8tx system. Google is shifting the host layer of its flagship TPU 8tx platform back to x86 CPUs, after previously relying on in house chips. The TPU 8tx infrastructure is designed with hardware enforced confidential computing to protect sensitive AI workloads running on Google Cloud.
